tools.description: Every shelf (African FX data + services) with price in USD, params, and how to pay. Payment is x402 (USDC on Base, settled by Coinbase). Free to call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load · Destructive: check_carrier_basics.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_shelves, check_carrier_authority, check_carrier_basics, check_broker_authority, vet_load, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, get_fx_official, get_fx_parallel, get_fx_africa_brief, check_tx_insurance_ce, check_tx_realestate_ce, buy_shelf_pass · Private data: get_pass_balance, check_carrier_authority, check_broker_authority, screen_sanctions_name, screen_sanctions_wallet, buy_shelf_pass · Public sink: check_carrier_basics, vet_load · Destructive: check_carrier_basics

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_shelves" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Every shelf (African FX data + services) with price in USD, params, and how to pay. Payment is x402 (USDC on Base, settled by Coinbase). Free to call." → after: "Data shelves (default) with price in USD, params, job-tool name and x402 URL. Pass kind=service or kind=all to include owner-fulfilled work. Free to call."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
